card.name: Start of a drug name after a break
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug or brand name when it begins a new sentence, heading, or phrase and is split into pieces, such as M in Mometasone or I in ICLUSIG. Usually follows a period, a heading, or a verb like restart.

card.writes: It pushes toward word-start pieces such as S, P, and unb, which suggests it helps begin a new name or word.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter or two of a drug name that is written in pieces, especially when a new sentence or section begins.
